naslov: AI Wars Ep. 21: Anthropic's Claude Riemann proof claim, OpenAI agents race
opis:
Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims he proved the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis with Claude, formalized in Lean, but there is no independent verification yet and Anthropic hasn't commented. The same day, Stanford's Ravi Vakil published a human proof of the generalized version by Alessandro Masullo, with no AI. OpenAI says its agents now complete nearly half of 2-4 hour research tasks on their own, up from about a quarter in March.

naslov: This week in AI: Anthropic on Nasdaq (November 15–21)
opis:
Anthropic defined the week: the company went public in the biggest IPO in history, and after an initial jump its stock fell about 10% on day two. The model race heated up: Alibaba released Qwen4-Max, OpenAI released GPT-6.2 with a lower price but a lukewarm reception, and Google released Gemini 4 Neon, which independent tests put at the top in coding for less money. Agents moved to the desktop and into operating systems, while incidents, lawsuits and defensive moves like Signal's screen blocking are growing alongside them.

naslov: What is AI distillation? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
Distillation means training a smaller AI model on the answers of a bigger one, so the student learns to copy the teacher. OpenAI says it suspends anywhere from a few thousand to a few tens of thousands of accounts every week for organized distillation of its models.
